segments: Three completely different mini-objectives power the elevator. Pick the cog you are currently working on and ignore the other two.
The cogs do not need to be collected in the order shown here. Route them around your GobbleGum, plant growth, shield charge, and current round.
Use the required GobbleGum after the elevator quest is active to reach the hidden room and grab the first cog.
Grow the three-round Blue Water + KT-4/Masamune artillery-shell plant, fire the AA cannon at the cargo plane, then recover the cog where it lands.
After every player completes all three Trials, charge the shield with the challenge lightning and use the electrified zipline setup to drop onto the hidden dock.
